glosses: dish rack, plate rack (a type of rack where plates are placed)
shelf (each of the horizontal panels of a cupboard, cabinet or bookcase)
shelf (a board fixed horizontally to a wall, on which various objects can be placed)

examples.en: The book is on the shelf.

examples.text: Eu peguei um livro da prateleira.
examples.en: I took a book from the shelf.
How many books are on the shelf?

examples.text: Não há muitos livros nestas prateleiras.
examples.en: There aren't many books on these shelves.
